topic: Choose a password-free login method for our small web app

scenario.topic: Choose a password-free login method for our small web app
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when choosing a password-free login method: ease of use, security, or setup complexity?

options.name: Email Magic Link Authentication
options.upside: Users log in via a one-time emailed link, no passwords needed
options.tradeoff: Relies on email delivery speed and inbox security
options.concern: Users without quick email access may face delays or frustration
options.best_for: prioritizing ease of use with minimal setup

options.name: WebAuthn Biometric Authentication
options.upside: Leverages device biometrics like fingerprint or face ID for secure login
options.tradeoff: Requires users to have compatible devices and browsers
options.concern: Some users may find biometric prompts intrusive or have privacy concerns
options.best_for: maximizing security and seamless user experience

options.name: SMS One-Time Passcode Login
options.upside: Users receive a code via SMS to log in without passwords
options.tradeoff: Costs increase with user volume and SMS delivery can be unreliable
options.concern: Phone number spoofing and SIM swapping attacks reduce security

options.name: OAuth Login via Google Accounts
options.upside: Users authenticate using their existing Google accounts, no password management needed
options.tradeoff: Users must have or create a Google account; dependency on third-party service
options.concern: Privacy-conscious users may object to Google data sharing
options.best_for: fast integration with strong security and familiar UX

shared_context: Our small web app targets about 500 monthly active users
We have a modest budget and limited developer time for integration
The decision group has exactly 3 participants

personas.name: Wyatt
personas.background: As a highly conscientious but low-agreeableness user, I prioritize strong security and familiar, reliable solutions for our app.
personas.private_goal: I want a login method with high security and a familiar user experience that minimizes password management risks.
personas.rejection_reason: Biometric authentication may be intrusive and raise privacy concerns, conflicting with my preference for straightforward, non-invasive security.

personas.name: Pavel
personas.background: I am moderately open and less conscientious, valuing a balance between security and user familiarity without complex setup.
personas.private_goal: I want a login method that balances moderate security with user familiarity and reasonable integration effort.

compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative

personas.name: Lila
personas.background: With moderate openness and high agreeableness, I favor solutions that maximize security while providing a seamless user experience.
personas.private_goal: I want a highly secure and seamless login method that leverages modern device capabilities for ease of use.
